authority_limit: The framework does not select lawful basis, resolve jurisdiction-specific obligations, prove compliance or accept residual privacy risk for a use site.
bounded_implication: Privacy risk management distinguishes data processing, individuals, organizational objectives, governance, control and communication outcomes.
title: NIST Privacy Framework 1.0

authority_limit: Protocol privacy guidance does not decide organizational purpose, legal authority, data-subject rights, retention or use-site acceptance.
bounded_implication: Privacy threats include surveillance, stored-data compromise, correlation, identification, secondary use, disclosure, exclusion and intrusion.
title: RFC 6973: Privacy Considerations for Internet Protocols

authority_limit: Vocabulary expression does not establish factual accuracy, legal validity, consent, enforcement, compliance or acceptance.
bounded_implication: Purpose, processing, personal data, data subject, recipient, location, measure, risk, right and legal/organizational basis are distinct concepts.
publisher: W3C Data Privacy Vocabularies and Controls Community Group
title: Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV)

authority_limit: Framework mapping does not prove a control is implemented, effective, sufficient for a threat model or accepted by a risk owner.
bounded_implication: Govern, identify, protect, detect, respond and recover are distinct cybersecurity outcome families with profiles and tiers.
title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0

authority_limit: A control catalog is not automatic applicability, implementation evidence, effectiveness proof, authorization or universal risk acceptance.
bounded_implication: Security and privacy controls are selected, tailored, implemented, assessed and continuously monitored against system and organizational requirements.
title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5

authority_limit: A risk estimate is not a control, authorization, safety case, legal determination or acceptance decision.
bounded_implication: Threat sources/events, vulnerabilities, likelihood, impact, uncertainty and risk determination are separate assessment inputs and outputs.
title: NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1: Guide for Conducting Risk Assessments

authority_limit: Zero-trust architecture does not prove identity, authorize every domain effect, guarantee least privilege or eliminate insider/provider risk.
bounded_implication: Resource access decisions use explicit policy, identity/device/context signals, enforcement points and continuous evaluation rather than network location alone.
title: NIST SP 800-207: Zero Trust Architecture

authority_limit: Practice evidence does not prove absence of vulnerabilities, semantic correctness, runtime isolation, safety or production fitness.
bounded_implication: Secure-development preparation, protection, production and vulnerability response require distinct practices and evidence.
title: NIST SP 800-218: Secure Software Development Framework

authority_limit: SLSA provenance does not prove source correctness, dependency safety, runtime behavior, semantic fitness or product acceptance.
bounded_implication: Supply-chain provenance and build levels bind scoped claims to artifacts, builders, materials and threat models.
title: SLSA Specification v1.2

authority_limit: ASVS coverage does not prove absence of vulnerabilities, infrastructure security, business authorization, privacy compliance or safety.
bounded_implication: Application-security requirements and verification levels can be tested as explicit controls rather than inferred from product labels.
title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard

authority_limit: A weakness taxonomy is not a threat model, exploit proof, risk score, control effectiveness verdict or acceptance decision.
bounded_implication: Weakness classes describe recurring software/hardware conditions that can contribute to vulnerabilities under particular contexts.
title: Common Weakness Enumeration

authority_limit: Media sanitization does not prove deletion from replicas, backups, disclosures, caches, derived data or external providers.
bounded_implication: Clear, purge and destroy are distinct sanitization methods with media, validation and disposition considerations.
title: NIST SP 800-88 Rev. 1: Guidelines for Media Sanitization

authority_limit: Key-management guidance does not prove implementation correctness, purpose authorization, semantic integrity or complete erasure.
bounded_implication: Cryptographic keys have types, protection requirements, cryptoperiods, states and lifecycle operations distinct from the data they protect.
title: NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev. 5

authority_limit: Secure-by-design principles are not a complete threat model, executable control contract, conformance proof or risk acceptance.
bounded_implication: Security outcomes, safe defaults, transparency and vulnerability responsibility should be product design obligations rather than shifted to users.
title: Secure by Design

authority_limit: NASA guidance does not choose hazards, severity criteria, controls or acceptance authority for unrelated enterprise systems.
bounded_implication: Hazards, causal factors, controls, verification, residual risk and acceptance are distinct safety-engineering artifacts and decisions.
title: NASA System Safety Handbook, Volume 1

authority_limit: STPA analysis does not prove implementation conformance, quantify all risk, replace domain expertise or authorize residual risk.
bounded_implication: Losses, hazards, system-level constraints, control structures, unsafe control actions and causal scenarios form distinct analysis steps.
publisher: MIT Partnership for Systems Approaches to Safety and Security
title: STPA Handbook

authority_limit: Attestation does not prove workload correctness, claim truth, authorization, privacy, safety or universal trustworthiness.
bounded_implication: Evidence, endorsements, reference values, appraisal policy, attestation results and relying-party decisions remain distinct trust stages.
title: RFC 9334: Remote ATtestation procedureS (RATS) Architecture
